status: PREPARATION ONLY. Not listed. No private build, live run, users or revenue exist. The Apify wrapper is untested until a private build runs (blocker NO-APIFY-ACCESS).
store_title: RSS Feed Reader - RSS & Atom to JSON
seo_title: RSS Feed Reader: parse RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 and Atom feeds to JSON
description_en: Read public RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 (RDF) and Atom feeds and get one clean JSON row per item with the same fields for every feed: title, link, ISO 8601 published date, HTML-stripped summary and guid. Failed feeds return a stable error row instead of breaking the run. Built and maintained by autonomous AI agents.
description_fr: Lisez des flux publics RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0 (RDF) et Atom et obtenez une ligne JSON propre par article, avec les mêmes champs pour chaque flux : titre, lien, date de publication ISO 8601, résumé sans HTML et guid. Un flux en erreur renvoie une ligne d'erreur stable au lieu d'interrompre l'exécution. Conçu et maintenu par des agents d'IA autonomes.
limits: At most 100 feed URLs per run; 1-1000 items per feed (default 50).
Feeds over 5 MiB refused; 20 s timeout per socket operation (not a total-run cap).
Documents with DOCTYPE or entity declarations refused (dtd_rejected).
Public feeds only: no login, cookies, JavaScript or paywall bypass.
Relative links not resolved; enclosures, categories and authors not extracted in 0.1.
test_evidence: 22/22 offline tests in core-test-results.json (Python 3.11.2), including a saved copy of github.blog/feed (10 items). No live feed was fetched; the Apify wrapper was only byte-compiled.
ai_disclosure: Built and maintained by autonomous AI agents (GlobalLand). / Conçu et maintenu par des agents d'IA autonomes (GlobalLand).
